vassals.title: Magistrate
grievances: House Alabrook ruled Uvulal until 292 and has never forgotten it.

hooks.title: A Lord in Revolt
hooks.text: Magistrate Lainar of Vidlikr has closed the gates to the crown's tax-gatherers. House Alabrook ruled Uvulal until 292 and has never forgotten it. Grand Syndic Lisaelas needs a go-between before blood is spilt.

hooks.title: Wagons Turned Back
hooks.text: Grand Syndic Braskymund the Wise has closed the border to carts from Uvulal, and the carters' guild is threatening to march on Uvuleil. Grand Syndic Lisaelas needs proof the blockade breaks an old treaty.

hooks.title: A Crown Contested
hooks.text: Grand Syndic Lisaelas came to power only 1 years ago, and Magistrate Lainar of House Alabrook has never accepted it. Letters are passing between the claimant and lords who remember the old house.

hooks.title: Opened Graves
hooks.text: Old graves from the Harvest Pox have been opened in the night. The folk of Uvulal whisper that someone wants the sickness back.

hooks.title: The Buried Charter
hooks.text: Scholars at Uvuleil believe Lemere, a walled village near Uvuleil settled in 7, hides records that could undo House Thyelydell's right to rule.

reasons: Two roads cross their shared border.
About 4,995 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought three wars in recorded memory.
Six roads cross their shared border.
About 8,056 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought four wars in recorded memory.
Two settlements changed hands between them by the sword.
The last war between them ended only 53 years ago.
Their peoples share a tongue and customs.

events.title: Uvuleil raises the banner of Uvulal
events.text: At Uvuleil the headmen of the country swear to one banner, and Uvulal begins.

events.title: House Thiaglen founds Uvulal
events.text: At the founding of Uvulal, the headmen of Uvuleil raise a chief from House Thiaglen to speak for them all.

events.title: Grand Syndic Thienda of Uvulal
events.text: Uvulal bows to Thienda, newly crowned Grand Syndic, of House Thiaglen.

events.title: Grand Syndic Miewen of Uvulal
events.text: Miewen takes the seat of Uvulal.

events.title: Uvuleil in flames
events.text: A fire in the lower lanes burns a third of Uvuleil.
events.name: The Burning Night of Uvuleil
events.backstory: The blaze began with a forgotten lamp in a chandler's loft; by morning Uvuleil was ash.

events.title: The Aasmychnen flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Uvuleil and Aasmychnen.
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 57 above Aasmychnen, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: High water at Ifyil
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Ifyil.
events.backstory: A storm drove the sea up the Thieeliebrook in 62, and the tide met the flood at Ifyil.

events.title: The Lithyod War
events.text: Old grievances at Lithyod set Lithlal and Uvulal at each other's throats.
events.name: The Lithyod War
events.backstory: Lithlal raised the toll on Lithyod bridge, Uvulal refused to pay, and the Lithyod War was the result.

events.title: The Treaty of Lithyod
events.text: Terms are read out at Lithyod: Lithyod to Lithlal, and a promise of quiet from Uvulal.

events.title: Lithlal takes Lithyod
events.text: Surveyors from Lithlal drive new stakes at Lithyod, and Uvulal does not send anyone to pull them up.
events.backstory: After the Lithyod War, the people of Lithyod found their new lords had little interest in their old customs.

events.title: The Marrow Chill comes to Uvulal
events.text: It breaks out in Uvuleil and spreads to Deemild, Fithlesos, Tytnen and 9 other places.
events.name: The Marrow Chill
events.backstory: Crowded barracks and foul latrines during the Lithyod War gave the Marrow Chill its start; by 64 it was loose in Uvuleil.

events.title: Grand Syndic Gliwen of Uvulal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Gliwen of House Thiaglen becomes Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: Silence at Lemere
events.text: Whole families die at Lemere, and the few who live join kin at Uvuleil.
events.backstory: The Marrow Chill emptied Lemere, and the walled village was abandoned in 66.

events.title: The sickness empties Glaglen
events.text: Whole families die at Glaglen, and the few who live join kin at Uvuleil.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Marrow Chill refused to remain at Glaglen, and the charcoal-burners' camp was left to the weeds in 66.

events.title: The electors of Uvulal choose
events.text: The ring of the elders is passed to House Aliebrook, and Uvulal has a new ruling family.
events.name: The Electors' Oath at Uvuleil
events.backstory: Thiaglen ruled until 94, when the assembly of Uvulal gave the office to House Aliebrook.

events.title: Grand Syndic Laera the Lame of Uvulal
events.text: Laera the Lame takes the seat of Uvulal.

events.title: The Ifyogolf Quarrel
events.text: Raiding and reprisals around Ifyogolf turn into open war between Lithlal and Uvulal.
events.name: The Ifyogolf Quarrel
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Ifyogolf until Lithlal and Uvulal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: Grand Syndic Mianynden of Uvulal
events.text: Mianynden of House Aliebrook is raised as Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: The Peace of Ifyogolf
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Lithlal and Uvulal swap hostages and go home.

events.title: The Frigmo Reckoning at Roloshonod
events.text: Envoys from Frigmo and Uvulal part in anger at Roloshonod, and within the season both are mustering.
events.name: The Frigmo Reckoning at Roloshonod
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Roloshonod, and by 109 both Frigmo and Uvulal had armies in the field.

events.title: The Treaty of Roloshonod
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Frigmo and Uvulal swap hostages and go home.

events.title: The electors of Uvulal choose
events.text: The electors of Uvulal raise House Elathorn to rule.
events.name: The Moot of Elathorn
events.backstory: The custom of Uvulal is to choose its rulers, and in 126 the electors passed over Aliebrook for House Elathorn.

events.title: Grand Syndic Vierylar the Patient of Uvulal
events.text: Uvulal bows to Vierylar the Patient, newly crowned Grand Syndic, of House Elathorn.

events.title: High water at Vidlikr
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Vidlikr and Erel.
events.name: The Drowning of Vidlikr
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 130, and Vidlikr was caught asleep.

events.title: Silt over Dabury
events.text: The flood leaves Dabury under silt; nobody rebuilds the hamlet.
events.backstory: Dabury lay in the path of the Drowning of Vidlikr, and the hamlet was given up in 130.

events.title: The Rig flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Vidlikr and Rig and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Thieeliebrook Rising of 138
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 138 above Rig, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: Todestead is abandoned
events.text: Todestead sits too low, and after the water the farmstead is not worth the digging out.
events.backstory: Todestead lay in the path of the Thieeliebrook Rising of 138, and the farmstead was given up in 138.

events.title: The Dafralm flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Dafralm.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 139, and Dafralm was caught asleep.

events.title: House Niawood elected in Uvulal
events.text: Delegates gather at Uvuleil and, after three days of argument, choose House Niawood to rule Uvulal.
events.name: The Moot of Niawood
events.backstory: Elathorn ruled until 141, when the assembly of Uvulal gave the office to House Niawood.

events.title: Grand Syndic Elyra of Uvulal
events.text: Uvulal bows to Elyra, newly crowned Grand Syndic, of House Niawood.

events.title: Soaham is abandoned
events.text: Soaham is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the walled village is then left to the owls.

events.title: The great flood at Ghirholg
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Grolgochryr and Ghirholg and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 143
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Ghirholg in 143.

events.title: High water at Bolfin
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Vidlikr and Bolfin and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 144 above Bolfin, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: Famine in Uvulal
events.text: Hunger spreads across Uvuleil, Vidlikr, Ifyil and 105 other places, and the granaries stand empty.
events.name: The Black Granary Winters
events.backstory: The silt left by the flood of 144 ruined the next sowing, and the hungry years of Uvulal followed.

events.title: The hungry road from Skevestrand
events.text: Skevestrand cannot feed itself, so the salt-works village walks to Neyndejeyd and does not return.
events.backstory: By 147, the Black Granary Winters had emptied the salt-works village of Skevestrand.

events.title: The hungry road from Meibrahavn
events.text: Hunger drives the people of Meibrahavn to Svismymranyrn, and the farmstead is left empty.
events.backstory: The Black Granary Winters starved Meibrahavn; the farmstead was left in 148.

events.title: The great flood at Fealulveamsai
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Fealulveamsai.
events.name: The Great Thieeliebrook Spate of 149
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 149, and Fealulveamsai had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Dredun is abandoned
events.text: Dredun cannot feed itself, so the market village walks to Rohonch and does not return.
events.backstory: Folk of Dredun walked away from the Black Granary Winters, and the market village was abandoned in 149.

events.title: The hungry road from Teiwick
events.text: Hunger drives the people of Teiwick to Tytaflal, and the farmstead is left empty.
events.backstory: By 149, the Black Granary Winters had emptied the farmstead of Teiwick.

events.title: The Blue Rot comes to Uvulal
events.text: It breaks out in Vekruflol and spreads to Vidlikr, Digoyld, Ikrum and 29 other places.
events.name: The Blue Rot
events.backstory: Years of hunger after the Black Granary Winters had left the folk of Vekruflol too weak to fight off the Blue Rot, which took hold in 152.

events.title: Dacoaham is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Dacoaham after the sickness, and the hunters' lodge falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Blue Rot emptied Dacoaham, and the hunters' lodge was abandoned in 152.

events.title: Gurthuholt is abandoned
events.text: Whole families die at Gurthuholt, and the few who live join kin at Rochorch.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Blue Rot reached Gurthuholt; by 154 the farmstead was empty.

events.title: The War of the Uvulal Marches
events.text: Frigmo marches on Dosilod, and Uvulal answers in kind; neither will name the first blow.
events.name: The War of the Uvulal Marches
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Dosilod, and by 155 both Frigmo and Uvulal had armies in the field.

events.title: A vote at Uvuleil
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Uvulal vote, and House Alialeaf wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Electors' Oath at Uvuleil of 160
events.backstory: In 160 a vote at Uvuleil ended the rule of Niawood, and House Alialeaf has held Uvulal since.

events.title: Grand Syndic Fielas the Tall of Uvulal
events.text: Fielas the Tall takes the seat of Uvulal.

events.title: The Obofralm flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Obofralm.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Obofralm.

events.title: The Peace of Dosilod
events.text: Exhausted, Frigmo and Uvulal make peace on the old borders.

events.title: The great flood at Zchiltol
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Zchiltol, Tohrolnichod and Rochryrod stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 161 above Zchiltol, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: High water at Uvuleil
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Uvuleil, Ifyil, Aasmychnen and 5 other places.
events.backstory: The sea came in over the dunes in 169 and the Thieeliebrook could not drain at Uvuleil.

events.title: The great flood at Lechegnen
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Lechegnen stand in brown water.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Lechegnen.

events.title: The great flood at Teafithveamsai
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Teafithveamsai.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Teafithveamsai.

events.title: The Lofithval Troubles
events.text: Old grievances at Lofithval set Frigmo and Uvulal at each other's throats.
events.name: The Lofithval Troubles
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Lofithval until Frigmo and Uvulal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: Grand Syndic Mywen of Uvulal
events.text: Uvulal bows to Mywen, newly crowned Grand Syndic, of House Alialeaf.

events.title: The Truce at Lofithval
events.text: A truce is cried at Lofithval; Frigmo and Uvulal both claim the credit and keep their land.

events.title: The great flood at Vidlikr
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Vidlikr, Rochorch and Bolfin stand in brown water.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Vidlikr in 203.

events.title: Vaeliahollow dies of thirst
events.text: Water must be hauled from far off to Vaeliahollow; in the end the walled village is simply abandoned.

events.title: The Dosilod War
events.text: Old grievances at Dosilod set Lithlal and Uvulal at each other's throats.
events.name: The Dosilod War
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Dosilod, and by 205 both Lithlal and Uvulal had armies in the field.

events.title: Saiwell is abandoned
events.text: Saiwell is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the shepherds' steading is then left to the owls.

events.title: The great flood at Roshchoch
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Roshchoch and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 211 above Roshchoch, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The Peace of Dosilod
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Lithlal and Uvulal swap hostages and go home.

events.title: Grand Syndic Thialiel of Uvulal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Thialiel of House Alialeaf becomes Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: The great flood at Grolgochryr
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Grolgochryr and Ghirholg.
events.name: The Thieeliebrook Rising of 220
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Grolgochryr in 220.

events.title: The fall of the Niyik galleries
events.text: The deep workings at Niyik come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: A spring broke into the deep gallery at Niyik in 222, and the pumps could not keep pace.

events.title: The great flood at Tytnen
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Uvuleil and Tytnen and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 223
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 223, and Tytnen was caught asleep.

events.title: High water at Ronot
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rochorch and Ronot.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 227 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The Ifyil flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Uvuleil, Ifyil and Fealulveamsai.
events.backstory: A storm drove the sea up the Thieeliebrook in 228, and the tide met the flood at Ifyil.

events.title: Alyelibrook lost to the water
events.text: The river takes the well, the fields and the footbridge of Alyelibrook, and the hamlet is let go.
events.backstory: The flood of 228 left Alyelibrook a swamp, and the hamlet was abandoned in 228.

events.title: The Uvuleil flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Uvuleil, Deemild, Tytnen and 4 other places stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 232 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The great flood at Tafin
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Obofralm and Tafin.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 232, and Tafin was caught asleep.

events.title: The Roloshonod Troubles
events.text: Raiding and reprisals around Roloshonod turn into open war between Lithlal and Uvulal.
events.name: The Roloshonod Troubles
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Roloshonod, and by 239 both Lithlal and Uvulal had armies in the field.

events.title: The Truce at Roloshonod
events.text: Terms are read out at Roloshonod: Roloshonod to Uvulal, and a promise of quiet from Lithlal.

events.title: Uvulal takes Roloshonod
events.text: Roloshonod is handed from Lithlal to Uvulal.
events.backstory: Uvulal claimed Roloshonod as the price of the Roloshonod Troubles, and Lithlal was in no position to refuse.

events.title: The Ykm flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Ykm stand in brown water.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 240, and Ykm had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Grand Syndic Raethar the Generous of Uvulal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Raethar the Generous of House Alialeaf becomes Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: The great flood at Obofralm
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Vidlikr, Obofralm, Tafin and 1 other places.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Obofralm in 242.

events.title: The Rolich flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rolich.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 242, and Rolich had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Rochryr
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rochryr.
events.backstory: A bank of the Thieeliebrook gave way in 244 above Rochryr, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The electors of Uvulal choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Uvulal vote, and House Vaeglen wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Moot of Vaeglen
events.backstory: Alialeaf ruled until 246, when the assembly of Uvulal gave the office to House Vaeglen.

events.title: Grand Syndic Alianiaril of Uvulal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Alianiaril of House Vaeglen becomes Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: The Leid flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Leid.
events.name: The Drowning of Leid
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Leid.

events.title: The Harvest Pox
events.text: It breaks out in Lithd and spreads to Alyod, Tilealiros, Haliros and 189 other places.
events.name: The Harvest Pox
events.backstory: The Harvest Pox began in Lithd in 248, where drinking water had been tainted ever since the Drowning of Leid.

events.title: The sickness empties Fewick
events.text: Whole families die at Fewick, and the few who live join kin at Jegrejeyd.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Harvest Pox refused to remain at Fewick, and the mill hamlet was left to the weeds in 248.

events.title: Collapse at the Zchiloch mines
events.text: The deep workings at Zchiloch come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: Rains soaked the hill above the Zchiloch mines, and in 249 the lowest gallery filled in an hour.

events.title: The sickness empties Ryladell
events.text: The sickness has emptied Ryladell; the survivors burn their belongings and walk away from the ferry village.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Harvest Pox refused to remain at Ryladell, and the ferry village was left to the weeds in 251.

events.title: The great flood at Zchiloch
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Zchiloch and Roshchoch.
events.name: The Drowning of Zchiloch
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 252, and Zchiloch had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Erel
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Erel and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: The sea came in over the dunes in 253 and the Thieeliebrook could not drain at Erel.

events.title: The great flood at Iril
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Iril and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Great Thieeliebrook Spate of 253
events.backstory: A warm wind in 253 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: A new house at Uvuleil
events.text: The last heir of the old line is buried, and House Alabrook is named to follow them.
events.name: The Heirless Winter of Uvulal
events.backstory: Vaeglen died out in 265, and the lords of Uvulal looked for the nearest kin they could find.

events.title: Grand Syndic Mienar of Uvulal
events.text: Mienar of House Alabrook is raised as Grand Syndic of Uvulal.

events.title: Raiders at Lesund
events.text: Lesund is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the market village is then left to the owls.

events.title: The fall of the Niglinan galleries
events.text: A seam gives way at Niglinan, and the rescue crews dig until the lamps run dry.
events.backstory: Water pooled in the old workings at Niglinan for a season, and in 269 it burst through into the working face.

events.title: The Amin flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Vylyfralm and Amin and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Thieeliebrook Rising of 273
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 273, and Amin had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The Bavintifralm flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Ykm and Bavintifralm stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 277 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Kar
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Kar and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Kar.

events.title: The Zchilsi flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Zchilsi.
events.name: The Great Thieeliebrook Spate
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 278, and Zchilsi was caught asleep.

events.title: The Lechegnen flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Lechegnen.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 278, and Lechegnen was caught asleep.

events.title: Tastrand given up to the raiders
events.text: Raiders return to Tastrand each autumn until the watchtower village has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: High water at Dayof
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Deemild and Dayof.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 287 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: A vote at Uvuleil
events.text: The electors of Uvulal raise House Thyelydell to rule.
events.name: The Choosing of 292
events.backstory: Alabrook ruled until 292, when the assembly of Uvulal gave the office to House Thyelydell.

events.title: Grand Syndic Lisaelas of Uvulal
events.text: Lisaelas of House Thyelydell is raised as Grand Syndic of Uvulal.
